data.description: This game was originally going to be the first project for me but I decided to make it a full game! It uses a revised version of the gorilla locomotion to be used for more! Zero gravity, swimming, wall crawling, and more!

changelog.change_log:
Happy New Year!

Here's the first update to start the year! Not too small but not too big!

Networking:
     - Faster Networking with new PlayFab Update

All Maps:
     - Lighting: Redone lighting everywhere with a new skybox and 
      lighting shouldn't blind players
     - Removed all Christmas 24' stuff

Forest:
     - Reskin
     - Grass instead of snow on floor now
     - Snow is gone and Rain is here!

Shop:
     - Removed Christmas LT Cosmetics


Plans:
     - New LT Cosmetics
     - If needed, Photon Update.
     - Floor is lava
     - Horror
     - Links on the computer for YT, Twitch, Discord, Website

Bug Fixes:

Bans:
 - Banning was broken and didn't show reasons/times. FIXED

Reporting:
 - If reported user didn't have a name set the report was useless. 
   Name is now required upon game start in-order to play.

Lighting:
 - Lighting was a bit dark so it has been modified and made 
   slightly brighter for better visibility.

Additions:

Mod Vents:
 - Moderators now have access to security cameras of each map 
   to see activity by players which can be used to give bans to 
   players.

Name Requirement:
 - Looping back to the Reporting, It is now required that before a 
   player can leave the Den (Starting Area), a name must be set 
   for online play.

Patch Notes for V0.2.1:

Hey gamers! I’m back with part 2 of the Christmas 24’ update! This is also combined with, drum roll pleaseeee, The Bouncy update!!! Now I was thinking about doing this separately but I figured why not make it your Christmas present! Well, I hope everyone has had a great december, has a great christmas, and I’ll be back once more this year with a smaller update for New Years.  With that said, let's get on with the patch notes!

I’ve brought on a completely new revamp to all the maps and the game itself! Now the forest is essentially the same, just slightly bigger and things are placed a little differently. I’ve completely remodeled the Den, Shop, Zero G, and added a new map! I also redid the entire lighting system. New gameplay system too!

- Forest:
     - Revamp!
     - Slightly bigger
     - Rearranged all items in the Forest

- Shop:
     - Revamp!
     - 10x Bigger
     - Changed the lighting
     - Added paths to 2 maps (ZeroG, Bounce House)
     - Changed up the mirror
     - 2 New Cosmetics

- ZeroG:
     - Revamp!
     - Made Map Bigger

- Bounce House:
     - New Map!
     - Located in Shop
     - Slide to enter
     - Jump on anything to bounce around!
     - Kiddie Birthday Party themed bounce pad!

- Lighting:
     - Revamp!
     - More “Life Like”
     - Some places are darker, might be adjusted

- Gameplay:
     - Using a new Tag system
     - New Tag system is infection at this time.

- Cosmetics:
     - Snail Collection Start!
     - Edible Chocolate Bar called the Wolf Bar

- Next Plans:
     - Possibly another new map
     - More cosmetics

Hey gamers! Sorry for the late update. I know I missed Halloween and Thanksgiving. A lot has happened and I just went through major surgery on my leg a few weeks ago. I haven't been able to test in VR mode so if something is wrong please let me know by emailing me at: wolfbromail@gmail.com. Anyways, lets get to it!

Christmas Update 1!!!!!!!

Den:

- Re-Detailed and added some more stuff for Christmas!
- MOTD Board!
- Alerts Tab on Computer

Forest:

- Re-detailed Forest for Wintery/Christmas Vibes.
- Added Santa with a free Santa Hat cosmetic.
- Reindeer across the Forest
- Santa Sleigh with presents (nothing special but can be fun to play in)

Shop:

- Added a Cart System!
  - Now when shopping for cosmetics you can add them to a cart 
    instead of instantly buying them. Now you have time to 
    hesitate! Plan to add a try on feature later!
- Reindeer shopping too? What's that about?

Zero G:

- WHY IS A REINDEER FLOATING AROUND?! HELP HIM!
Added Map loaders back, Join room trigger so your always in a lobby, ZeroG Zone, Lighting in the den, and 2 more Cosmetics. Time to work on the fall update!
Reworked entire game systems. Zero Grav and Lava Parkour will be back in future updates.
Added... *drum roll please* RISING LAVAAAAA (you must be in a lobby/room for the lave to work!)
With V0.4 there is now tag! Either Choose tag and join a lobby or choose casual to explore without tag! New gamemode tab on the computer! Mod vents soon!
added mod items, another lightsaber, fixed bugs with wardrobe
added tabs to computer and wardrobe and moved the free cosmetics to the wardrobe fixed the Miner hat!!!
Fixed the Forest map loader not working! added tabs to the wardrobe shelf in den and made it look nicer! enjoy! (Will fix broken miner hat next update!
Fixed map loaders being to close causing endless falling through the map
Fixed the Maploaders not allowing you to walk through
Added names, codes, color changer, shop system with den inventory, and map loaders.
Fixed Model size, fixed hand cosmetic scripts, and added a light saber cosmetic for right hand.
Fixed player Model too low causing Miner hat to be in the way of vision and moved spawn point back to den.
Patched the error where the Photon VR body would spawn out randomly, Added player model, opened shop with 2 FREE cosmetics (Miner Hat, Lightsaber)
Removed Christmas 23 items and added a day/night cycle. Audio permissions are needed for voice chat.
